modeReason: Three top stories (SpaceX's million-satellite AI orbit plan, the deepening Nvidia governance/credit crisis, and state AGs blocking a bankrupt chatbot company's private-chat auction) each score relevance 12, well past the fresh threshold of 8.
phrase: A space company won approval to put up to a million AI satellites into orbit. Meanwhile, a small town's lone records clerk is overwhelmed by a flood of AI-generated requests.
phraseAlternatives: A space company can now launch up to a million AI satellites. Back on Earth, one town clerk is buried in AI-driven paperwork.
Up to a million AI satellites got the green light for orbit. One small-town clerk still cannot get through today's inbox.
AI is heading to space by the million. In one small town, it is just heading to the records office.
A million AI satellites are now allowed in orbit. A single clerk on the ground is still fighting a paper mountain.

brief.concept: A space company launches a swarm of small AI satellites toward orbit while, on the ground, a single small-town clerk sinks beneath a rising pile of AI-driven paperwork.
brief.metaphor: AI reaches for the stars while ordinary bureaucracy drowns in its own paper trail.

cast.who: a swarm of small round AI satellites rising into a starry sky
a launch tower with a rocket shape at the base of the sky, sending the satellites up
a tired human records clerk sitting at a small desk, head in hand
a tiny town hall building with paper spilling out its door

brief.composition: Split composition, horizon line across the middle. Upper half: a dark night sky where a rocket-shaped launch tower at the horizon sends a curving trail of small round AI satellites up toward the top edge. Lower half: a small, modest town hall building, door overflowing with a tall, leaning stack of paper spilling onto the ground; the clerk sits at a tiny desk right beside the pile. Flat cut-paper layers, no gradients, each element its own solid color.
brief.alt: In a night sky, a rocket launches a cluster of small round AI satellites upward. On the ground below, a tired clerk sits at a desk beside a small town hall building that is overflowing with spilling paperwork.
